questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Took way too long to get the course list and had to change the subjects i wanted because of a mistake from the university (wrong ECTS mark of a specific course)

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Just go through mobility

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: International office.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Not very succesful. Wrong ECTS's given at one of the courses, had problems with enrolling in master-program, under-grad and graduate program

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Dont go

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Very low level. no curriculum and very superficial.

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: Very low.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Very low. Only PP-presentation. i didn't learn anything and scored highest mark. complete joke.

questions.answer: its very european, but no-one speaks english.

questions.answer: they are very young so didnt socialise much.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: language, music (brazilian funk, ugh) food. horrible food.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: the beach

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: dont buy into the stuff about safety. it is very safe. Even though i didn't like my stay that much, the people are nice, they dont scam you and it is very safe. dont worry. Host institution is very small. maybe choose one that is a bit bigger like PUC.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: if you have a question ask the international office. they are very helpful, though sometimes they cant fix everything.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: learning that I love Denmark and a high academic level. Going to FGV is basically 4 months of beach vacation. Turns out that is not my cup of tea.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: money and dealing with the disappointment of the food.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Go with a good friend. host institution is very small so chance of finding exchange friends can be hard + very limited social activities at the school.

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
